subject.title: Feature: Telegram Reactions - Two-Way Support with Prompt Guidance

question: Should incoming Telegram reaction interpretation extend the existing `reactionLevel` prompt contract, or should OpenClaw add a separate `reactionGuidance` setting?
rationale: The requested setting overlaps a shipped prompt-control surface, and coupling outbound guidance to inbound notification delivery would change existing behavior; repository policy requires deliberate judgment before expanding config/default surfaces.

options.title: Extend existing policy
options.body: Keep `reactionLevel` as the outbound control and append incoming soft-signal guidance only when `reactionNotifications` is not off.

options.title: Add separate guidance control
options.body: Add `reactionGuidance` only after defining distinct off/minimal/full semantics and explicit composition with both existing settings.

options.title: Keep outbound guidance only
options.body: Leave incoming reactions as plain system-event context and decline automatic emoji interpretation in the system prompt.

recommendation.title: Extend existing policy
recommendation.body: Keep `reactionLevel` as the outbound control and append incoming soft-signal guidance only when `reactionNotifications` is not off.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original feature, own the later channel-prompt boundary refactor, and have already participated in product triage for this issue.
